title: Retry with backoff
diff:
--- a/client.py
+++ b/client.py
@@ -10,7 +10,10 @@ def fetch(url):
-    for attempt in range(3):
+    for attempt in range(5):
         try:
             return http.get(url, timeout=5)
         except TimeoutError:
-            continue
+            time.sleep(2 ** attempt)
     raise FetchError(url)

expect.change: Retries go from 3 to 5 and now wait with exponential backoff between attempts instead of retrying at once.

title: Guard a missing profile

expect.change: badge() no longer throws for a user without a profile or plan; it falls back to the free plan.

title: Rename a CLI flag
diff:
--- a/cli.go
+++ b/cli.go
@@ -22,3 +22,4 @@ func flags(fs *flag.FlagSet) {
-	fs.Bool("no-colour", false, "disable colour output")
+	fs.Bool("no-color", false, "disable color output")
+	fs.Bool("no-colour", false, "deprecated: use --no-color")
 }

expect.change: The flag --no-colour is renamed to --no-color; the old spelling stays as a deprecated alias.

title: Add a database index
diff:
--- a/migrations/0042_orders.sql
+++ b/migrations/0042_orders.sql
@@ -0,0 +1,2 @@
+CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY idx_orders_customer_placed
+  ON orders (customer_id, placed_at DESC);

expect.change: Adds an index on orders by customer and newest order first, created concurrently so the table is not locked.

title: Fix the last page
diff:
--- a/paginate.rb
+++ b/paginate.rb
@@ -8,3 +8,3 @@ def pages(total, per_page)
-  total / per_page
+  (total + per_page - 1) / per_page
 end

expect.change: The page count rounded down, so a partly filled last page was dropped; it now rounds up.
